title: Deep Learning Essentials: Understanding Softmax and Cross-Entropy in CNNs

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back to the course on Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到深度學習課程。

cues.en: This is an additional tutorial to talk about the softmax in cross-entropy functions.
cues.zh: 這是補充教學，介紹 Softmax 與交叉熵函數。

cues.en: It is not 100% necessary in order for you to go through all of the parts that we've been through in the main part of this section where we're talking
cues.zh: 要理解本章主要內容，也就是前面介紹的

cues.en: about the convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 卷積神經網路，不一定非得看這堂課。

cues.en: But at the same time, I thought it would be a good addition to your bag of knowledge and skill sets.
cues.zh: 不過，我認為它能補充你的知識與技能。

cues.en: So, let's go ahead and dig into these functions.
cues.zh: 我們來深入了解這兩個函數。

cues.en: So, to start off with, what we have here is the convolutional neural network that we built in the main part of the section, and then, at the end,
cues.zh: 首先，這裡是本章主要內容中建立的卷積神經網路，最後

cues.en: it pops out some probabilities: 0.95 for a dog and 0.05 or 5% for a cat given that photo in the left as an input.
cues.zh: 輸出一些機率：以左邊照片作為輸入，狗的機率是 0.95，貓則是 0.05，也就是 5%。

cues.en: This is after the training has been conducted.
cues.zh: 這是完成訓練之後的情況。

cues.en: This is actually, it's running and it's classifying a certain image.
cues.zh: 它正在執行，對某張影像分類。

cues.en: And so, the question here is how come these two values add up to 1?
cues.zh: 問題是，為什麼這兩個值加起來是 1？

cues.en: Because, as far as we know, from everything that we've learned about artificial neural networks, there is nothing to say that these two final neurons are connected
cues.zh: 根據目前學過的人工神經網路知識，沒有任何地方說這兩個最後的神經元

cues.en: between each other.
cues.zh: 彼此有連接。

cues.en: So, how would they know what the value of the how would each one of them know what the value of the other one is and how would they know to add their values up to 1?
cues.zh: 那每個神經元如何知道另一個的數值，又如何知道兩者加起來必須是 1？

cues.en: Well, the answer is they wouldn't in the classic version of artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 答案是，在傳統人工神經網路裡，它們並不知道。

cues.en: And the only way that they do is because we introduce a special function called the softmax function in order to help us out of the situation.
cues.zh: 之所以能做到，是因為加入了名為 Softmax 的特殊函數，協助處理這個問題。

cues.en: So, normally, what would happen is the dog and the cat neurons would have any kind of real values.
cues.zh: 一般而言，狗與貓神經元可以輸出任意實數值。

cues.en: They don't have to add up to 1.
cues.zh: 它們不必加總為 1。

cues.en: But then we would apply the softmax function, which is written up over there at the top, and that would bring these values to be between 0 and 1
cues.zh: 但套用上方寫出的 Softmax 函數後，這些值會落在 0 到 1 之間，

cues.en: and it would make them add up to 1.
cues.zh: 並且加總為 1。

cues.en: And, to quote Wikipedia, the softmax function, or the normalized exponential function, is a generalization of the logistic function
cues.zh: 借用維基百科的說明，Softmax，也就是正規化指數函數，是邏輯斯函數的一般化形式，

cues.en: that, quote, unquote, squashes a k-dimensional vector of arbitrary real values to a k-dimensional vector of real values in the range of 0-1
cues.zh: 會把含任意實數的 k 維向量，壓縮成數值範圍介於 0 到 1 的 k 維實數向量，

cues.en: that all add up to 1.
cues.zh: 而且所有值加總為 1。

cues.en: So, basically, it does exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 基本上，正好符合我們的需求。

cues.en: It brings these values to be between 0-1 and makes sure that they add up to 1.
cues.zh: 讓數值介於 0 到 1，並確保加總為 1。

cues.en: And the way it works is that, the way that this is possible is that, because at the bottom over here you can see that there's a summation.
cues.zh: 它之所以辦得到，是因為這裡分母有加總運算。

cues.en: So, it takes the exponent and puts it in the power of Z and adds it up so Z 1 is 2 across all of your classes, all of these values,
cues.zh: 對各類別的 z 值計算指數，例如 z1、z2，再把這些值加起來，

cues.en: and so there, that's your normalization happening right there.
cues.zh: 正規化就在這裡發生。

cues.en: So, that's how the softmax function works.
cues.zh: 這就是 Softmax 的運作方式。

cues.en: And it makes sense to introduce the softmax function into convolutional neural networks because how strange would it be if you had
cues.zh: 在卷積神經網路裡加入 Softmax 很合理。想想，如果只有

cues.en: possible classes of a dog and a cat and for the dog class you had probability of 80% and for the cat class you had a probability of 45%, right?
cues.zh: 狗與貓兩個可能類別，卻說狗的機率是 80%、貓的機率是 45%，不是很奇怪嗎？

cues.en: It just doesn't make sense like that, and, therefore, it's much better when you introduce the softmax function and that's what you'll find happening most of the time in convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 那樣不合理，所以加入 Softmax 會比較好。卷積神經網路中也經常會這樣做。

cues.en: Now the other thing is that the softmax function comes hand-in-hand with something called the cross-entropy function and it's a very handy thing for us.
cues.zh: 另外，Softmax 通常和交叉熵函數搭配使用，對我們很有幫助。

cues.en: So, let's first look at the formula.
cues.zh: 先看公式。

cues.en: This is what the cross-entropy function looks like.
cues.zh: 這就是交叉熵函數的樣子。

cues.en: We're actually going to be using a different calculation.
cues.zh: 我們實際會用另一種計算方式。

cues.en: We're gonna be using this representation of the cross-entry, but the result's basically the same.
cues.zh: 使用這種交叉熵的表示方式，但結果基本相同。

cues.en: This is just easier to calculate.
cues.zh: 只是這樣比較容易算。

cues.en: And what, I know, this might sound very unrelated to anything right now, just formulas on your screen, but there'll be some additional recommended reading at the end of this section.
cues.zh: 我知道，現在螢幕上只有公式，可能感覺和其他內容沒關係，不過本章結尾會提供延伸閱讀。

cues.en: So, don't worry if you're not picking up on the math, like, if we haven't explained the math right now.
cues.zh: 如果還沒掌握數學也別擔心，因為目前還沒解釋這些數學。

cues.en: But the point here is that what is the cross-entropy?
cues.zh: 重點是，交叉熵究竟是什麼？

cues.en: Well, a cross-entropy function.
cues.zh: 交叉熵函數，

cues.en: Remember how we, previously in artificial neural networks, we had a function called the mean squared error function, which we used as the cost function
cues.zh: 還記得前面的人工神經網路中，用均方誤差函數作為成本函數，

cues.en: for assessing our network performance and our goal was to minimize the MSE in order to optimize our network performance.
cues.zh: 評估網路表現，目標是最小化 MSE，讓網路表現最佳化。

cues.en: Well, that was our cross function there and in convolutional neural networks we can still use MSE but a better option, in convolutional neural networks
cues.zh: 那是當時的成本函數。在卷積神經網路仍可以用 MSE，但更好的選擇，

cues.en: after you apply the softmax function, turns out to be the cross-entropy function.
cues.zh: 在套用 Softmax 之後，會是交叉熵函數。

cues.en: And in convolutional neural networks when you apply the cross-entropy function it's not called the cost function anymore it's called the loss function.
cues.zh: 在卷積神經網路中使用交叉熵時，就不再稱為成本函數，而稱為損失函數。

cues.en: And they're very similar and they're just little terminological differences and like little, a bit different in what they mean.
cues.zh: 兩者很相似，只是術語及意義有些微差異。

cues.en: But for our purposes, it's pretty much the same thing.
cues.zh: 對我們目前的目的而言，基本上可以視為同一回事。

cues.en: And what happens is the loss function is, again, something that we want to minimize in order to maximize the performance
cues.zh: 我們同樣希望最小化損失函數，以最大化

cues.en: of our network.
cues.zh: 網路表現。

cues.en: So, let's have a look at a quick example on how this function can be applied.
cues.zh: 先看一個簡單例子，了解如何套用這個函數。

cues.en: So, let's say we've put an image of a dog into our network, the predicted value for dog is 0.9, and this is during the training so we know
cues.zh: 假設把狗的影像輸入網路，狗的預測值是 0.9。這是在訓練期間，所以知道

cues.en: the label that is a dog.
cues.zh: 標籤是狗。

cues.en: So, the predicted value is 0.9.
cues.zh: 狗的預測值為 0.9，

cues.en: The predicted value for cat is 0.1.
cues.zh: 貓的預測值為 0.1。

cues.en: Then here we have the label so we know it's a dog because this is training and 01 for dog, 0 for cat.
cues.zh: 這裡是標籤。因為是訓練，所以知道是狗：狗為 1，貓為 0。

cues.en: And, so, in this case, you need to
cues.zh: 在這個例子中，需要

cues.en: plug these numbers into your formula for the cross-entropy.
cues.zh: 把這些數值代入交叉熵公式。

cues.en: So, how you would do it is: The values on the left going to the variable queue, the one that is under the logarithm on the right side and the values
cues.zh: 左邊的值放進 q，也就是右側公式中對數裡面的變數；

cues.en: from the right would go into P.
cues.zh: 右邊的值則放進 p。

cues.en: And so it's important to remember which one goes where because, if you get them wrong, you don't wanna be taking a logarithm from a 0 value or a logarithm from a 1.
cues.zh: 一定要記得各自放哪裡，因為放錯就會對 0 或 1 取對數，這不是你想要的。

cues.en: So you just want to plug them in, make sure you plug them into the correct places, and then you, basically, add that up.
cues.zh: 確認代入正確位置，再把各項加起來。

cues.en: So, that's how the cross-entropy works and actually right now we just going to look at a specific step-by-step example of applying this function
cues.zh: 交叉熵就是這樣運作。接著會逐步看一個具體例子，把這個函數

cues.en: in real life and it'll kind of make more sense what cross-entropy is.
cues.zh: 實際用一次，交叉熵的意義就會更清楚。

cues.en: My goal in this tutorial is to make you more comfortable with cross-entropy because it can sound very convoluted and, (laughs) no pun intended,
cues.zh: 這堂課希望讓你更熟悉交叉熵，因為它可能聽起來很曲折複雜，（笑）可不是刻意玩雙關，

cues.en: it can, like, convolutional neural networks, it can sound very complex, right?
cues.zh: 像卷積神經網路一樣，聽起來可能很複雜，

cues.en: Scary.
cues.zh: 很嚇人。

cues.en: But it's not.
cues.zh: 但其實不是。

cues.en: That's the point.
cues.zh: 這就是重點。

cues.en: So, let's go ahead and apply it just so we know that it's not scary.
cues.zh: 動手套用，就知道沒那麼可怕。

cues.en: So, here's neural net - and also this will explain why we're doing this, why we are looking into different cost functions.
cues.zh: 這裡有神經網路。這也會解釋為什麼要研究不同成本函數。

cues.en: So, Neural Network 1, Neural Network 2, let's say we have 2 neural networks, and then we parse an image of a dog.
cues.zh: 假設有神經網路 1 和神經網路 2，輸入一張狗的影像。

cues.en: And we know that this is a dog and not a cat.
cues.zh: 我們知道這是狗，不是貓。

cues.en: And then we have another image of a cat this time, an animal, and it's a cat not a dog.
cues.zh: 另一張則是貓，不是狗。

cues.en: And here we have a weird-looking animal which is, in fact, a dog not a cat if you look very closely.
cues.zh: 這裡還有一隻外形奇特的動物，仔細看，實際是狗，不是貓。

cues.en: So, we wanna see what our neural networks will predict.
cues.zh: 看看神經網路會如何預測。

cues.en: In the first case, Neural Network 1: 90% dog.
cues.zh: 第一張，神經網路 1：90% 是狗，

cues.en: 10% cat.
Correct.
cues.zh: 正確。

cues.en: Neural Network #2: 60% dog.
cues.zh: 神經網路 2：60% 是狗，

cues.en: 40% cat.
Still correct.
cues.zh: 仍然正確。

cues.en: Worse, but correct.
cues.zh: 比較差，但還是正確。

cues.en: Second option, 1st Neural Network: 10% dog.
cues.zh: 第二張，神經網路 1：10% 是狗，

cues.en: 90% cat.
Correct.
cues.zh: 正確。

cues.en: Neural Network #2: 30% dog.
cues.zh: 神經網路 2：30% 是狗，

cues.en: 70% cat.
Worse, but still correct.
cues.zh: 比較差，但仍然正確。

cues.en: And, then, finally
cues.zh: 最後，

cues.en: in image 3, Neural Network 1: 40% dog.
cues.zh: 第三張，神經網路 1：40% 是狗，

cues.en: 60% cat.
Incorrect.
cues.zh: 錯誤。

cues.en: Neural Network #2: 10% dog.
cues.zh: 神經網路 2：10% 是狗，

cues.en: 90% cat.
Incorrect and worse.
cues.zh: 錯誤，而且更差。

cues.en: So, the key here is that even though both networks got it wrong in the last one, throughout all three images, Neural Network 1 was outperforming Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 重點是，雖然最後一張兩個網路都猜錯，但三張整體看來，神經網路 1 都比神經網路 2 好。

cues.en: So, even in the last case,
cues.zh: 即使最後這個例子，

cues.en: it gave dog, like, a 40% chance as opposed to Neural Network 2 only gave dog a 10% chance.
cues.zh: 網路 1 仍給狗 40% 的機率，相較之下，網路 2 只給 10%。

cues.en: So, Neural Network 1 is outperforming across the board when compared to Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 所以在所有例子裡，神經網路 1 都優於神經網路 2。

cues.en: And so, now we're going to look at the functions that can measure performance that we've kind of talked about already.
cues.zh: 接著看前面提過、能衡量表現的函數。

cues.en: So, let's put these into a table.
cues.zh: 把這些結果放進表格。

cues.en: So, there's Neural Network 1.
cues.zh: 這是神經網路 1。

cues.en: You have the row number, so that's the image number.
cues.zh: 這裡是列號，也就是影像編號。

cues.en: And then for Image 1, you have what it's predicted: 90% dog, 10% cat.
cues.zh: 第一張影像的預測為 90% 狗、10% 貓。

cues.en: So those are the hat variables.
cues.zh: 這些是帶帽符號的預測變數。

cues.en: And then you have the actual values.
cues.zh: 接著是實際值。

cues.en: So dog, correct.
cues.zh: 狗是正確類別，

cues.en: Cat, incorrect.
cues.zh: 貓不是。

cues.en: Same thing for Image 2 and same thing for Image 3.
cues.zh: 第二張、第三張影像也一樣。

cues.en: And same for Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 神經網路 2 也是如此。

cues.en: So dog, 60%.
cues.zh: 第一張預測狗 60%，

cues.en: Cat 40% in the first image, that's what it predicted.
Correct answer was dog not cat and so on.
cues.zh: 正確答案是狗而非貓，其他依此類推。

cues.en: And so, now, let's see what errors we can actually get.
cues.zh: 現在看看能得到哪些誤差。

cues.en: So, what errors we can calculate to estimate the performance and monitor the performance of our networks.
cues.zh: 也就是能計算什麼誤差，來估計並監控網路表現。

cues.en: So, one type of error is called the classification error and that is, basically, just asking did you get it right or not?
cues.zh: 其中一種是分類錯誤，基本上只問：猜對了嗎？

cues.en: Regardless of the probabilities, it's just did you get it right or did you not get it right?
cues.zh: 不管機率是多少，只看猜對或猜錯。

cues.en: So, in both cases, and for both neural networks, each of them they got one or, so this is how many they got wrong.
cues.zh: 兩個神經網路都錯一張；這裡計算的是錯誤數量。

cues.en: So, they got 1 out of 3 wrong.
cues.zh: 三張中錯了一張。

cues.en: So 33% error rate for Neural Network 1 and 33% error rate for Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 所以神經網路 1 錯誤率是 33%，神經網路 2 也是 33%。

cues.en: And so, basically, from this standpoint, both neural networks perform at the same level.
cues.zh: 從這個角度，兩個網路的表現相同。

cues.en: But we know that's not true.
cues.zh: 但我們知道實際並非如此。

cues.en: We know that Neural Network 1 is outperforming Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 神經網路 1 比神經網路 2 好。

cues.en: That's why a classification error is not a good measure, especially for the purposes of back propagation.
cues.zh: 所以分類錯誤不是很好的衡量方式，尤其不適合反向傳播。

cues.en: Means squared error.
cues.zh: 再看均方誤差。

cues.en: Different.
cues.zh: 情況不同了。

cues.en: And by the way, I did these calculations in Excel.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，我用 Excel 做了這些計算。

cues.en: I just didn't want to bore you with them but you can totally just sit down and do them on a paper or in Excel.
cues.zh: 不想用計算過程讓你覺得無聊，但你完全可以在紙上或 Excel 裡算。

cues.en: These are very straightforward calculations.
cues.zh: 計算很直接。

cues.en: Just, basically, take the sum of squared errors and then just take the average across your observations.
cues.zh: 基本上，把平方誤差加總，再對觀測值取平均。

cues.en: And that's, that's pretty much it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: So, for Neural Network 1, you get 25%.
cues.zh: 神經網路 1 得到 25%，

cues.en: For Neural Network 2, you get 71% error rate.
cues.zh: 神經網路 2 得到 71% 的誤差率。

cues.en: So, as you can see, this one is more accurate.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這種衡量比較精確，

cues.en: It's telling us that Neural Network 1 has a much lower error rate than Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 告訴我們網路 1 的誤差遠低於網路 2。

cues.en: And, then, cross-entropy, again, we've seen the formula.
cues.zh: 再來是交叉熵，公式已經看過。

cues.en: You can also calculate this.
cues.zh: 你也可以自行計算。

cues.en: This is actually even easier to calculate than the mean squared error.
cues.zh: 它甚至比均方誤差更容易算。

cues.en: Cross-entropy gives you 38% for Neural Network 1 and 1.06 for Neural Network 2.
cues.zh: 交叉熵給網路 1 的結果是 38%，網路 2 則是 1.06。

cues.en: So, you can see the results are a bit different when you look at them like that, when you look at, you know, the mean squared error and cross-entropy.
cues.zh: 可以看到，用均方誤差與交叉熵衡量時，數字有些不同。

cues.en: The question of why would you use cross-entropy over
cues.zh: 但為什麼選交叉熵，

cues.en: mean squared error isn't just about the kind of, like, the numbers that they spit out.
cues.zh: 而非均方誤差，不只是看它們算出的數字。

cues.en: These calculations were just to show you that this is all, it's all doable.
cues.zh: 這些計算只是讓你知道，一切都能自己算出來，

cues.en: You can just do it on a paper.
cues.zh: 用紙筆就可以。

cues.en: It's not, these are not very intense mathematics.
cues.zh: 這不是很艱深的數學，

cues.en: These are pretty simple straightforward things.
cues.zh: 而是相當簡單直接的計算。

cues.en: But the question of why would you use mean cross entropy over mean squared error, it's a very good question to ask.
cues.zh: 但為什麼使用交叉熵而非均方誤差，確實是個好問題。

cues.en: I'm glad you asked it.
cues.zh: 很高興你問了。

cues.en: The answer to that is, there's several advantages of cross-entropy over mean squared error which are not obvious.
cues.zh: 答案是，交叉熵相較於均方誤差，有幾個不那麼明顯的優點。
